summary: Implemented the window title feature in the repository without committing or running anything. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title), gated only on is_terminal and returning a bool; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run, so the tests and mypy are unverified; the Windows renderer test only runs on win32.
